n, d, max_limit = map(int, input().split())

def get_gcd(a, b):
    while b != 0:
        a, b = b, a % b
    return a

gcd_value = get_gcd(n, d)
n //= gcd_value
d //= gcd_value

if max_limit >= d:
    print(f"{n}/{d}")
else:
    ratio = n / d
    min_difference = ratio
    best_num = 0
    best_den = 1
    for i in range(1, max_limit + 1):
        scaled = i * ratio
        floor_scaled = int(scaled)
        diff1 = abs(floor_scaled / i - ratio)
        diff2 = abs((floor_scaled + 1) / i - ratio)
        if min_difference > diff1 or min_difference > diff2:
            if diff1 > diff2:
                best_num = floor_scaled + 1
            else:
                best_num = floor_scaled
            best_den = i
            min_difference = min(diff1, diff2)
    print(f"{best_num}/{best_den}")
</translated_code>
